selector_resolution.formula: A != 0 && B == 0 ? 8 : 4; re-read at each use
selector_resolution.scan_scope: Every mapped raw PE section byte position: ModRM RIP disp32 candidates, overlapping direct memory operands up to 64 bytes, FS/GS excluded; exact whole-file RVA/VA literals. Byte-position candidate census, not a proof about register-indirect stores, encoded addresses, bulk copies, or whole-program reachability.

B_changes.caller_scope_summary: 0x422fe00 passes a stack byte for the old B, sets B=1 before stream I/O, and clears B on exit iff the old byte was zero. This is not a proven BASIC_PERSON load path.
B_changes.absolute_literal_caveat: Two literal VA hits are not recognized executable store instructions by this analysis; no dataflow attribution.

writer_crosscheck.W_select_caveat: writer A != reader A; related alternate format, not proof of reader runtime flags.

selector_resolution.why_file_W8: All successful paths using the exact 20B base read match the full frame, ordinals, and repeated-ID dwords only with all reference sites taking W=8. Pdob year independently rules out W=4 for class 4. Class 5 has no W.

unclosed.subject: A=1 assignment and reader invocation order
unclosed.reason: No decoded direct nonzero writer or exact VA/RVA literal for A. The only decoded overlapping store sets A=0. Indirect/encoded stores and a complete startup-to-table-load chronology were not closed. The file determines W=8, not an invariant for arbitrary editor sessions.

unclosed.subject: outside current input or arg3=0
unclosed.reason: The byte map is limited to the framed current basic_people payload; the reader can skip the 20B base suffix or choose W=4 under other flags.

unclosed.subject: unnamed wire fields / identity semantics
unclosed.reason: obj+0x38, +0x18, +0x66 not mapped to a person schema property. Internal Pdva/Pcww/PLag and secondary ID word are not counted as pers fields; rdui is not dispatched by this BASIC_PERSON getter. Do not name the ordinal rdui.

unclosed.reason: 8B physical spans and getter member provenance are fixed, but neither the meaning of each dword nor the 271-property schema in its entirety is closed.
